title: Judgment and Salvation

questions.question: I was ready to be sought by those who did not ask for me; I was ready to be found by those who did not seek me. I said, "Here I am, here I am," to a nation that was not called by my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 65:1 (ESV): "to a nation that was not called by my name."

questions.question: I spread out my hands all the day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, following their own what?
A people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens and making offerings on what?
Who sit in tombs, and spend the night in secret places; who eat pig's flesh, and broth of tainted meat is in their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 65:4 (ESV): "and broth of tainted meat is in their vessels;"

questions.question: Who say, "Keep to yourself, do not come near me, for I am too holy for you." These are a smoke in my nostrils, a fire that burns all the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 65:5 (ESV): "a fire that burns all the day."

questions.question: Behold, it is written before me: "I will not keep silent, but I will repay; I will indeed repay into their what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 65:6 (ESV): "I will indeed repay into their lap"

questions.question: Because they made offerings on the mountains and insulted me on the hills, I will measure into their lap payment for their former what?
Thus says the LORD: "As the new wine is found in the cluster, and they say, 'Do not destroy it, for there is a blessing in it,' so I will do for my servants' sake, and not destroy them what?"
I will bring forth offspring from Jacob, and from Judah possessors of my mountains; my chosen shall possess it, and my servants shall dwell where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 65:9 (ESV): "and my servants shall dwell there."

questions.question: But you who forsake the LORD, who forget my holy mountain, who set a table for Fortune and fill cups of mixed wine for whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 65:11 (ESV): "and fill cups of mixed wine for Destiny,"

questions.question: I will destine you to the sword, and all of you shall bow down to the slaughter, because, when I called, you did not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 65:12 (ESV): "because, when I called, you did not answer;"

questions.question: For behold, I create new heavens and a new earth, and the former things shall not be remembered or come into what?
No more shall there be in it an infant who lives but a few days, or an old man who does not fill out his days, for the young man shall die how old?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 65:20 (ESV): "for the young man shall die a hundred years old,"

questions.question: They shall build houses and inhabit them; they shall plant vineyards and eat their what?
The wolf and the lamb shall graze together; the lion shall eat straw like the ox, and dust shall be the serpent's food. They shall not hurt or destroy in all my holy what?

key_verse_text: For behold, I create new heavens and a new earth, and the former things shall not be remembered or come into mind.
